jd:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Build AI for the systems the world relies on. At IBM Z, our technology supports the transactions and data behind banking, payments, and global commerce. We are bringing AI into that foundation to help developers build faster, simplify complex operations, and solve problems where reliability, security, and performance matter.

As an AI Software Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to turn advances in large language models into useful software. Depending on your team, you could build an agent that helps diagnose system issues, connect AI to enterprise data and tools, or create a simpler way for developers to work with complex systems. Bring your ideas, experiment, and help take a feature from prototype through testing and refinement.

What You’ll Do



- Design, build, and test AI-powered features that address real developer and client needs, with guidance from experienced engineers.
- Integrate LLMs, APIs, and enterprise data into applications, exploring agent workflows, tool calling, and retrieval where they fit the problem.
- Write clear specifications and effective prompts, use AI development tools thoughtfully, and review and test the code they produce.
- Evaluate AI behavior with realistic test cases, measure quality and performance, and improve how applications handle incorrect outputs and failures.
- Debug across model interactions, application code, APIs, and underlying systems to understand root causes and build reliable solutions.
- Collaborate through Git, code reviews, and technical discussions; document your work and iterate on feedback.

Program Dates: Internship start dates vary based on your academic calendar.



-  Semester System: May 24, 2027 – August 13, 2027
-  Quarter System: June 14, 2027 – September 3, 2027

Candidates must be available to participate for the full duration of the internship corresponding to their academic schedule.

Location Flexibility: By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and agree to be considered for any of the listed locations associated with this position and are willing to work at the location where you are ultimately assigned.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, and testing.
- Proficiency in Python and experience building applications or services that integrate APIs.
- Hands-on experience building an application or working prototype with LLMs. You can explain what you built, how you integrated the model, and how you tested its behavior. Experience may come from personal, academic, open-source, or internship projects.
- A systematic debugging mindset: you can investigate failures, test assumptions, and reason about how application code, data, models, and underlying systems interact.
- Ability to translate a problem into clear requirements, prompts, and testable acceptance criteria, and critically evaluate AI-generated code and responses.
- Familiarity with Git, clear technical communication, and the ability to learn quickly and collaborate on a team.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience



- Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus. You do not need experience with every technology listed.
- AI agents and tool or function calling; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Independent AI projects, open-source contributions, or experiments beyond assigned coursework that demonstrate initiative and thoughtful engineering decisions.
- Additional programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript or Go, and familiarity with distributed systems or microservices.
- Operating system concepts such as concurrency, multithreading, and memory management; relational databases and SQL.
- Cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift; observability, search, or real-time data processing tools such as OpenSearch or Kafka.
- AI evaluation, anomaly detection, or experience measuring and improving model accuracy, latency, and reliability.

We are especially interested in what you have built and learned. Where available, include a project link, repository, demo, or a brief description of your contribution and the technical challenges you worked through.
fit_why: Strong fit: LLM/RAG integration, Python, APIs, full-stack experience match

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Our Summer Internship program is a wonderful opportunity for Fall and Spring graduates to immerse themselves in an innovative and mission driven culture. Our paid internship program will provide you with hands on mentorship, an opportunity to add real contribution to our company via your internship project, and a possible job offer at the end. You will have the chance to make lifelong friendships, expand your network, and learn all about what it's like to work in a high-growth, fast scaling tech unicorn. You'll take part in company sponsored events and enjoy exploring a new city. Read on below to learn more about this unique internship!

About The Role



- Shield AI's Software Development Engineer Intern program spans engineers who design, build, and test the code that powers our autonomous systems — from user-facing applications and embedded flight software to machine learning models and the underlying systems platforms that tie it all together. Over 10–12 weeks, interns work alongside full-time engineers to analyze requirements, write and debug production-quality code, and ship a real feature or capability using our standard Agile development practices.
- Example Intern Projects

- Applications: Build a new feature or internal tool (web, mobile, or desktop) that streamlines a mission-planning or fleet-management workflow.
- Firmware/Embedded: Develop and debug embedded C/C++ code for a flight controller or sensor module, including bring-up and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
- Machine Learning: Train, evaluate, and integrate a perception or decision-making model (e.g., object detection, sensor fusion) into an autonomy pipeline.
- Systems Development: Extend a platform tool, API, or data pipeline that supports autonomy software, simulation, or cloud infrastructure.
Required Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
- Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., C, C++, Python, Java, or JavaScript)
- Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
- Experience writing, testing, and debugging code, whether through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships
- Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous requirements into working code
- Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications



- Exposure to mobile or web application frameworks and full-stack development
- Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, real-time operating systems, or assembly-level debugging
- Coursework or projects involving machine learning, statistics, probability theory, or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Experience with cloud platforms, databases, networking, or distributed systems
- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
- Prior internship, research, or club/competition experience in robotics, autonomy, or aerospace applications
- Interest in or exposure to the defense, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry

#intern

Shield AI is proud to offer competitive pay and a housing stipend for qualified hires. While our People Experience team provides resources and assistance, interns are responsible to find their own housing and travel to and from their office location.

###

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Job Description

With over 130 years of experience navigating in some of the world’s most complex and difficult waters, Seaspan Marine is the largest and most diverse tug & barge company on Canada’s West Coast, providing more than 2,500 ship assist & escort services annually, while our fleet of over 100 specialty and general-purpose barges provide critical transportation for many of BC’s largest industries and major marine construction projects.

The Intern, Data Engineering, will support the Data & Digital Enablement team in developing, testing, and documenting data solutions that enable analytics and business decision-making across Seaspan Marine Group. Working alongside experienced data professionals, the intern will gain hands-on experience with cloud data engineering, data integration, data modeling, data quality, and analytics within a Microsoft Azure environment.

Note: Due to business needs, this position is required to be fully on-site based at 10 Pemberton Avenue, North Vancouver.

What You’ll Do



-  Evaluate potential data sources and APIs based on data availability, reliability, technical constraints, and project requirements. 
-  Develop and test data pipelines using SQL, Python, and related programing languages to ingest, transform, and integrate data. 
-  Troubleshoot and improve data workflows, including scheduling, logging, error handling, and reruns. 
-  Transform source data into standardized datasets and data models for analytics and reporting. 
-  Perform data profiling and validation, and support the implementation of data-quality checks and monitoring. 
-  Document data sources, pipelines, models, technical requirements, and solutions. 
-  Follow established development and source-control practices and participate in code reviews. 
-  Participate in Agile activities and collaborate with technical and business stakeholders. 
-  Present project outcomes and support solution handover and knowledge transfer. 


What You’ll Bring



-  Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. 
-  Coursework, academic projects, or personal projects involving databases, data engineering, analytics, or software development. 
-  Working knowledge of SQL and Python. 
-  Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn. 
-  Exposure to cloud platforms, Databricks, Git/version control, or Azure tools is an asset. 


Why you’ll love working here 



-  A supportive learning environment, great team culture and hands-on experience and training. 
-  Opportunity to grow your career and connect with like-minded students. 
-  To assist those that are using transit, we operate a complimentary shuttle bus Monday through Friday with various pick up and drop off points around North Vancouver. 


Start Date of Internship: Monday, January 4, 2027.

End Date of Internship: Friday, April 30, 2027.

Please submit your Resume, Cover Letter and Academic Transcript as one PDF document. 

Application Closing Date: Friday,November 27, 2026, at 11:59pm PDT.

Please note: if we receive a large volume of applications, we may close this posting ahead of the closing date, therefore, we recommend applying early. Only those applicants under consideration will be contacted.

To learn more about our InternSHIP Program, visit our website: www.seaspan.com/internships-at-seaspan/

About Us

With over 130 years of experience navigating in some of the world’s most complex and difficult waters, Seaspan Marine is the largest and most diverse tug & barge company on Canada’s West Coast, providing more than 2,500 ship assist & escort services annually. Our fleet of energy and specialty barges fuels international trade and is integral to building a stronger British Columbia. Seaspan Ferries serves the Vancouver Island supply chain with the most reliable, daily commercial ferry service between our terminals on the Mainland and Vancouver Island. Seaspan Energy operates a fleet of LNG powered vessels with established, long-term relationships for the procurement and bunkering of LNG.

Seaspan is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including, women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities. If you require any accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruit@seaspan.com for confidential support. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment.
fit_why: Data pipelines with SQL/Python fit; Azure and on-site are secondary

We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

Reliable Robotics has year-round internship opportunities for students pursuing a degree in computer science, electrical/computer engineering, robotics or a similar field of study. Successful candidates will work alongside senior engineers to design, develop and test production systems.

Responsibilities



- Take ownership of software projects from design through implementation and test
- Implement elegant flight software for sensors, control systems, actuators, telemetry, fault handling and other vehicle subsystems
- Develop and enhance the software simulation framework that accelerates testing of safety-critical systems
- Work with peers to establish requirements for software
- Participate in peer review of system requirements, architecture, and software
- Plan and execute end-to-end system tests in simulation, on flight hardware in the lab, and in the air

Basic Success Criteria



- In-progress college degree in computer science, electrical/computer engineering, or similar
- Experience with C/C++

Preferred Success Criteria



- Understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and networking
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Attention to detail

Overview

 We are designing the Grid of the future ! 

We are innovators by nature , for over 50 years, Electric Power Engineers, LLC (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe to focus on complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As an early leader in the renewables space, we continue to see significant opportunities to build a sustainable and secure Grid.  Join a team committed to making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live.  Join us in leading the change!

Internships at Electric Power Engineers, Inc. are more than just a job, they’re an experience! Our interns bridge theoretical classroom concepts and hands-on training to overcome real-world challenges. Throughout your internship, you will develop skills to advance professionally and academically.

The   Power Systems  Software  Engineering Intern  will assist the team in the user developmwnt of power systems scripts in ENER-i powerflow software.  This position will report to an experienced Engineer and be exposed to exciting projects building valuable industry knowledge. Through this opportunity, the intern will gain hands-on experience and perform research in-line with study requirements.
